request.prompt:
Use the supplied EXACT project ZOMBIE LORD reference as the only character design. A massive corpulent undead boss, pale gray-green mottled stitched skin, HUGE round exposed distended belly as the center of mass, tiny hunched neck and broad snarling head with sparse dark hair, very thick heavy arms and oversized bare feet. Preserve rusted nails/spikes in shoulder/back, heavy gold-rusted chains draped around neck/shoulders/chest and attached wrist shackles, ragged gray-brown skirt/loincloth, ornate antique gold pointed waist plate/belt. Both hands are EMPTY heavy fists/claws with connected chains; do not invent a sword, axe, shield, cape, horns or wings. Keep the SAME exceptional belly volume, broad shoulder/hip proportions, face, chain hardware and original muted palette in every pose. High-detail painted rendered mythic-tier fantasy RPG sprite, fixed elevated orthographic isometric camera. Non-graphic monster art: old mottled scar/stitch texture, no fresh blood or internal organs. Ignore unrelated tiny fragments at reference crop edges; reconstruct the complete top of head and full intact toes, never crop them.

CAMERA MUST OVERRIDE REFERENCE'S FRONTAL CAMERA: TRUE REAR VIEW, facing directly AWAY to screen TOP, camera behind. Show ONLY broad back, nape, rear chains/spikes and rear of legs; NO face, NO front chest, NO belly button, no frontal waistplate. Both heels and rear toes aimed AWAY. Right anatomical leg is screenRIGHT; left leg screenLEFT.

Exactly SIX distinct consecutive poses, TWO columns and THREE rows, row-major chronological 0,1 / 2,3 / 4,5. Very heavy grounded fast shuffle RUN cycle (no slim runner and no floating). Pose0 RIGHT foot forward plants weight, LEFT leg trailing. Pose1 RIGHT foot compresses supporting full mass while LEFT heel/toes lift and left knee bends BEHIND. Pose2 RIGHT foot supports while LEFT knee and entire LEFT foot swing FORWARD above ground. Pose3 LEFT foot forward plants weight, RIGHT leg trailing. Pose4 LEFT foot compresses supporting full mass while RIGHT heel/toes lift and right knee bends BEHIND. Pose5 LEFT foot supports while RIGHT knee and whole RIGHT foot swing FORWARD above ground ready to loop pose0. This is a real opposite-foot support exchange; pose3 cannot use the same support foot as pose0. Both complete bare feet and knees visible below ragged skirt. The belly may hide upper thighs, never hide both feet. At least one sole grounded each pose. Heavy hips and belly shift toward planted support foot, belly lags with mass, shoulders/arms and attached chains counter-swing with weight. Chains remain attached, no floating rings. Keep same physical scale in all six cells, no per-pose fitting.

Transparent sprite sheet with pure alpha0 background. Six complete separate full-body figures central40% of evenly spaced cells with huge transparent margins between every bounding rectangle. One connected body per cell, chains attached. No ground plane, no castshadow, no text, no grid, no lines, no border, no labels, no specks/haze/particles. Full head, toes and chains never cut off.
